title: 5 Lakes Louise, Moraine, Emerald, Peyto & Bow Lake Banff Jasper
includes: Visit Marble Canyon From Oct 13- May 31 only
In winter, crampons will be provided and use at your own responsibility
Visit Moraine Lake From June 1 - Oct 12 only
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
policies: Pack your own lunch or buy grab-to-go at Fairmont Café Lake Louise
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Meet your local guide in Calgary, Canmore, or Banff. Drive toward Lake Louise, and enjoy a perfect photo opportunity by the pristine shores of the glacial lake.

Continue to Moraine Lake and take in spectacular views of the scenic lake surrounded by mountains. (Visit Moraine Lake from June 1 to October 12 only. During Oct 13 - May 31, the alternative will be Marble Canyon)

Head to Yoho National Park, visit stunning Emerald Lake and immerse yourself in the powerful waters of the awe-inspiring Natural Bridge.

Next, discover the area's picturesque Peyto and Bow Lake.
